repairs.issue: 모든 집중피해 회복을 첫챔피언으로 제한 및knockdown범위추정,정신집중조건누락과거리통계충돌 수정
repairs.correction: 아래 ruleChecks에 기록된 최종 조건·대상·단위로 최소 수정; before 원본과 candidate 비교 가능
repairs.quote: Warwick leaps a huge distance that scales with his Move Speed, Suppressing the first champion he collides with while he channels for 1.5 seconds. He attacks that champion 3 times over the duration, dealing (175/350/525 + (167% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage. Warwick heals for 100% of all damage dealt during the channel. This Ability applies On-Hit and On-Attack effects 3 distinct times over its duration, and does not Critically Strike. This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

proposalDecisions.reason: that champion은 직전 first champion he collides with를 지시; 첫충돌챔피언 피해대상 정확.
궁극기 공격/효과는 that champion인 첫충돌챔피언에3회; 구조화조건이 충돌횟수3회를 뜻하지 않음.
본문 enemies가 챔피언/첫충돌로 한정되지 않으므로 해당 조건 제거.
